notes: is.lines_raw = 10-K statement of income (first column) followed by the earnings-release condensed statement lines (prefixed "[Q4 release ...]"), which add dividends per share and weighted average shares; mapped keys use the 10-K. is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). Total company orders for the year are not published (release: fourth-quarter orders only). The FY2015 10-K later re-presented the FY2014 balance sheet (total assets 4,919 vs 4,931.2 here) and cash flow; this record is as originally reported. Self-checks: all pass.
